verdict.rationale: Blink is a native SSH and Mosh client built on libssh/libssh2. Users connect straight to a host with `ssh [user@]hostname` or `mosh [user@]hostname`, and it supports proxycommand and tunnels as optional extras. Community users report fast direct use on their LAN. missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that no vendor cloud relay or proxy sits in the connection path, and independent hands-on confirmation of relay-free direct connections beyond LAN anecdotes.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can connect directly to my servers without relying on a cloud relay, proxy, or VPN

citations.quote: In Blink type ssh [user@]hostname. For example : ssh irwin@irwinvb.
In Blink type mosh [user@]hostname. For example : mosh irwin@irwinvb.
It is built on top of libssh and libssh2.
